description: Get current quote and company data (price, market cap, PE ratio, 52-week range, etc.) for one or more stock symbols (comma-separated). A single symbol returns one quote object; multiple symbols return a paginated batch of quotes plus per-symbol errors.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted = first page

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = curated default set

lang.description: Target language for translated text fields (BCP 47, e.g. "ja", "zh-Hant"); English or omitted = no translation

limit.description: Maximum symbols per page; omitted = curated default (25)

name: get_quote
title: Stock Quote
